snappy_blocks.config.title: Snappy Blocks
snappy_blocks.tagline: Blocks and items move instead of blinking.
snappy_blocks.setting.enabled.desc: Off: blocks and items behave like vanilla.
snappy_blocks.setting.calm.desc: Smaller movements, no hit-stop, no hop.
snappy_blocks.setting.pop.desc: Placed blocks grow into place with a small overshoot.
snappy_blocks.setting.pulse.desc: The block bulges with every mining hit.
snappy_blocks.setting.pulseStyle.desc: What the block you mine does with every hit: bulge, shake, or wobble like jelly.
snappy_blocks.setting.burst.desc: Broken blocks squash and shrink into their drop.
snappy_blocks.setting.breakStyle.desc: How a broken block turns into its drop: squash and shrink, or spin away.
snappy_blocks.setting.pulseStrength.desc: How strong the mining animation is: how far the block moves, and how hard the bits fly.
snappy_blocks.setting.breakStrength.desc: How strong the break animation is: how far the block moves, and how many bits fly and how far.
snappy_blocks.setting.chips.desc: Bigger bouncing bits on top of vanilla's particles. Turn off if another mod does block particles.
snappy_blocks.setting.placeEffect.desc: What happens where you place a block, as it lands.
snappy_blocks.setting.placeStrength.desc: How strong the placing effect is: how much of it, and how far it goes.
snappy_blocks.setting.cubes.desc: Block bits, vanilla crumbs too, are small tumbling cubes.
snappy_blocks.setting.items.desc: Drops spring out, hop on landing and merge smoothly.
snappy_blocks.setting.pickup.desc: Picked-up items fly into their hotbar slot.
